known_secrets.text: During a deep irrigation repair, I found stonework that does not match any known terrace design.
It was beneath older layers of the irrigation channel.
The structure looked deliberate, not natural.
I didn't report it right away.
When I checked again later, part of it had been buried by silt once more.
I suspect the hills shift more than people admit.
Marisha once told me she thinks the grain stores sometimes 'go missing faster than they should.'
I think she's right, but I have no proof.

unknowns: Connection between families and the old carvings
Meaning of the carvings near the irrigation stonework
